Name: TC12 – Head Coach: notification count resets when DM menu is clicked
Description: Badge must drop to 0 after opening the first DM conversation.

Name: TC03-TC04 – Admin DM: badge pill visible before open, clears after opening conversation
Description:
TC03: Admin nav badge must NOT be present on dashboard.
        TC04: DM badge pill appears briefly on entering DM section, then disappears once conversation opens.

Name: TC14 – Head Coach: notification count remains correct after page refresh
Description: Badge count must survive a page refresh.

Name: TC13 – Head Coach: count decrements when an individual message is read
Description: Badge count must decrease after opening one conversation.

Name: TC08 – Head Coach: badge hidden or zero when all messages are read
Description: Badge must be hidden or zero after all conversations are opened.

Name: TC01 – TC02 Admin Role: DM badge visibility follows role permissions , Admin Hover State: no tooltip/count shown on hover
Description: DM nav link must be visible/enabled; Admin role must NOT show a tooltip or count on hover.

Name: TC20 – Head Coach: badge and tooltip are accessible to screen readers
Description: Badge should carry aria-label; xfail if missing.

Name: TC17 – Head Coach: badge is properly aligned on the DM nav item
Description: Badge must be adjacent to nav item (within 50px).

Name: TC05 – Admin Send Message: Admin can send a reply in a DM conversation
Description: Admin must be able to type and send a reply message in a DM conversation.

Name: TC21 – Head Coach: notification count loads correctly after hard reload
Description: Badge count must survive a hard (cache-bypassing) reload.

Name: TC19 – Head Coach: badge color follows design visibility standards
Description: Badge background must not be transparent or white.

Name: TC07 – Head Coach: badge count increments when a new DM arrives
Description: Badge must show ≥1 after a new DM is received.

Name: TC09 – Head Coach: tooltip is displayed on badge hover
Description: Tooltip must appear when hovering the DM badge.

Name: TC10 – Head Coach: tooltip shows correct participant count text
Description: Tooltip must contain a digit or the word 'participant'.

Name: TC06 – Head Coach: notification badge displays unread count
Description: Badge must be visible with count > 0 when unread DMs exist.

Name: TC11 – Head Coach: badge count and tooltip count match exactly
Description: Badge count and tooltip numeric value must match.

Name: TC22 – Head Coach: multiple DMs from same participant counted only once
Description: Sending 3 DMs from same user must increment badge by exactly 1.

Name: TC23 – Head Coach: badge reflects correct total from multiple different participants
Description: Badge increment must equal the number of new unique participants.

Name: TC24 – Head Coach: badge count is consistent across two browser tabs
Description: Both tabs must show the same badge count when loaded from the server.

Name: TC15 – Head Coach: unread DM count is restored correctly after re-login
Description: Badge count must be the same after logout + login.

Name: TC18 – Head Coach: badge renders double-digit counts without truncation
Description: Badge width must be ≥18px when count ≥10.

Name: TC16 – Head Coach: no tooltip shown when unread count is zero
Description: No tooltip must appear when badge count is zero.
